criteria.description: Project builds successfully with lake build
All tests pass with lake test
No sorry in proof or source files

verify.run: ! grep -rn 'sorry' --include='*.lean' Qed/ Tests/ Main.lean 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^--' | grep -v '^\s*--'

criteria.description: Conventional commit hook is present and executable
CI workflow exists and validates build + test + sorry check

verify.run: test -f .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'lake build' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'lake test' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'sorry' .github/workflows/ci.yml

criteria.description: Core types define VerifyType with all five verification constructors

verify.run: grep -q 'command' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'agentReview' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'property' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'proof' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'human' Qed/Types.lean

criteria.description: LoopState defines all required states including stuck detection

verify.run: grep -q 'ready' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'workerRunning' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'verifying' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'passed' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'stuck' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'maxIterationsReached' Qed/Types.lean && grep -q 'escalated' Qed/Types.lean
